name: Chheng Lydiya
headline: Embedded Systems · Robotics · Software Development
summary: Network & Telecommunication Engineering student at the Institute of Technology of Cambodia, expected to graduate in 2028. Builds embedded firmware, robot control software, and developer tools, connecting physical systems with the interfaces and infrastructure used to operate them.

experience.title: Software and AI Department · Control System Track
bullets: Contributes to robot control systems: semi-autonomous control for an omnidirectional robot and development of the team's current swerve platform.
Built an Android navigation application as a learning project.
Trains new members in Python, development environments (venv, Docker, and basic Ubuntu), and ROS 2 through the 2026–2027 intensive course.
Teaches microcontroller programming and control-system fundamentals.

experience.title: Internship · Jetson Infrastructure & AI Integration
bullets: Built infrastructure connecting IP cameras and AI web software on NVIDIA Jetson, including model extraction and GPU processing pipelines.
Adapted the software stack to vendor firmware, upgraded Jetson firmware, and tested the integrated camera and AI pipeline.
Built middleware and adapted the web software to integrate with it.
